name: Neil Tunmore

bio.statement: Tunmore's pamphlet statement lists 37 years at Intel in finance, human resources, facility management and construction.
bio.excerpt: 37 years Intel, Finance, Human Resources, Facility Management, Construction departments

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Tunmore says tax dollars spent should always add value to the city.
positions.excerpt: Tax dollars spent should always add value to our city

positions.statement: Tunmore's pamphlet statement says decisions should be based on facts, not politics.
positions.excerpt: Decisions should be based on facts not politics

positions.statement: Tunmore's pamphlet statement prioritizes neighborhood safety and identifying pathways around schools.
positions.excerpt: Prioritize safety & security of our neighborhoods. Identify pathways around schools.

positions.statement: Tunmore's pamphlet statement says the state government in Salem oversteps.
Tunmore's campaign site says spending decisions should serve the city's long-term interests and prepare it for future generations.
positions.excerpt: Spending decisions should serve the long-term interests of our city and wisely prepare it for future generations.
